propositions: The original claim that link-audit --repair fails due to ModuleNotFoundError for rebar_reconciler was disproven; the function correctly prepends engine_dir() to sys.path before importing.
The reconciler in-flight guard check_pass_lock correctly honors lease expiry, returning False when a 120-second lease has expired and True while active.
The first repair attempt coincided with a live lease (117s of 120s), not an import failure; the refusal was correct guard behavior, not a defect.
A frozen heartbeat in refs/reconciler/lock (sampled identically across 12 samples over 2 minutes) indicated the lock holder was not renewing, confirming intended lease-expiry semantics.
_reconciler_in_flight function lacks test coverage but exhibits no functional defect and behaves as documented.
